TARC: TO ACQUIRE REMAINING 50% STAKE IN NIBLIC GREENS HOSPITALITY 🏨

• Board approves acquisition of 25,000 equity shares for ₹55 lakh

• Transaction represents the remaining 50% stake in Niblic Greens Hospitality

• Post acquisition, Niblic Greens Hospitality will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of TARC

• Niblic operates in the tourism & accommodation sector, including hotels and motels

• Acquisition expected to be completed on or before March 31, 2027

ZYDUS LIFESCIENCES: PARTNERS WITH SENTYNL FOR ALVELESTAT 💊

• Sentynl Therapeutics signs option & license deal with Mereo BioPharma for alvelestat, a potential first-in-class treatment for rare lung disease

• Deal gives Sentynl exclusive US commercialization rights if option is exercised

• Mereo could receive up to $40 Mn in upfront & R&D payments, plus royalties on US sales

• Alvelestat is being prepared for global Phase 3 trials

JBM AUTO, OLECTRA, ASHOK LEYLAND: E-BUS & E-TRUCK PUSH ⚡🚌

• Govt considering interest subvention for electric buses and e-trucks

• Less than 1,000 e-trucks above 3.5-tonne capacity currently in India

• ₹4,391 Cr allocated for 14,028 electric buses under PM E-Drive

• 13,800 e-buses allocated through CESL tenders; 200 to J&K

• Charging proposals worth ₹710-715 Cr approved under PM E-Drive

• Additional ₹190 Cr charging infrastructure proposal under consideration

BAJAJ ELECTRICALS: APPOINTS KRISHNAN SUNDARAM AS CHIEF GROWTH & NEW BUSINESS OFFICER 🚀

• 🏢 Previously served as Chief Executive Officer at Vini Cosmetics

* EPL: Reports record 25.3% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,387.9 Cr and 15.2% EBITDA growth to ₹261.2 Cr, while raising revenue growth guidance to high-teens.

* VENKY'S: Poultry revenue rose 8.66% YoY, Animal Health revenue increased 17.21%, while Oilseed revenue surged 65.99% in Q1 FY27.

* IKIO TECHNOLOGIES: Revenue outside India grew 53% YoY to ₹110.1 Cr, while other businesses grew ~53% to ₹124.4 Cr as diversification accelerates.

* JAI CORP: Fully resumes operations at its Vasona plastic processing unit from August 11 after an earlier disruption, with financial impact still under assessment.

* IDEAFORGE TECHNOLOGY: Expects defence order inflows to accelerate in H2 FY27, particularly in Q3–Q4, while maintaining 50–55% FY27 blended gross-margin guidance.

* JAIN IRRIGATION: Maintains double-digit FY27 growth guidance and expects stronger H2 recovery, supported by improved reservoir levels, stable polymer prices and solar-pump demand.

* EXICOM TELE-SYSTEMS: Targets consolidated EBITDA break-even within Q2/Q3 FY27, while expecting 3x FY27 revenue growth from Tritium.

* GOLDIAM INTERNATIONAL: Plans to deepen its presence in Canada and expand into the Middle East and Israel amid improving lab-grown diamond pricing for smaller sizes.

* ASTRA MICROWAVE: Targets 15%+ FY27 revenue growth and sees ₹8,000–9,000 Cr potential order opportunities over the next 3–4 years.

* PATEL ENGINEERING: Targets ~10% FY27 revenue growth and ₹8,000 Cr order inflow, while planning ₹150–200 Cr non-core asset monetisation for debt reduction.

* REDTAPE: Targets ~20% EBITDA margin and plans to open 150+ stores in FY27 while scaling Ozark and Brandy brands.

* TVS SUPPLY CHAIN SOLUTIONS: Aspires to mid-teens FY27 revenue growth after 29% Q1 growth and continues targeting a 4% PBT margin.

* POWERICA: Reiterates double-digit FY27 growth guidance, supported by DG-set demand and wind projects, with margin recovery expected from Q3 FY27.

* INFO EDGE: Recruitment billings grew 17.5% YoY to ₹553 Cr and 99acres billings rose 16.5% to ₹110 Cr, while AI products scale up.

* YATHARTH HOSPITAL: Q1 revenue surged 51% YoY to ₹392.7 Cr and EBITDA rose 39% to ₹91.7 Cr, with bed capacity exceeding 2,800.

* YATHARTH HOSPITAL: New hospitals show strong ramp-up, with Faridabad reaching EBITDA breakeven in nine months and Agra achieving 20%+ EBITDA margin.

* VARDHMAN POLYTEX: Reports ₹1.63 Cr profit, up 757% YoY, after recognising a ₹309.55 Cr exceptional gain from full and final Phoenix ARC debt settlement.

* CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL: Raises FY27 consolidated sales growth guidance to 15% and sharply upgrades ceramics growth guidance to 23–25%, while retaining ₹400 Cr CapEx plan.

* LEHAR FOOTWEAR: Q1 footwear revenue grows 9% to ₹58.1 Cr, EBITDA margin improves to 9.4%, and Kundli capacity is being doubled to ~2 lakh pairs/month.

* LEHAR FOOTWEAR: Holds ₹40+ Cr OEM order pipeline, with expanded Kundli capacity scheduled to commence in September 2026.

* RAYMOND LIFESTYLE: Plans to raise Europe’s share of exports to up to 25% in two years while reducing US dependence to 55–60%, Reuters reports.

* ZEE ENTERTAINMENT: Expects festive recovery to support advertising revenue, while ZEE5 momentum and subscription revenue are expected to strengthen in Q2.

* STAR CEMENT: Cuts FY27 volume growth guidance to 8–9% from 11–12% due to Assam floods while retaining ₹1,500–1,600 EBITDA/ton guidance.

* AKUMS DRUGS: Expects double-digit CDMO volume growth and guides FY27 margins at 14–15%, with ₹240 Cr Zambia order contribution expected from H2 FY27.

* SHARDA MOTOR: Sees growth opportunities from lightweighting, CAFE III, BS7, China+1, localisation, exports and powertrain-agnostic products.

* ADVIT JEWELS: Q1 topline rises 37.35% YoY, EBITDA grows 33.02% and net profit increases 37.86%, driven by premium jewellery demand.

* H.G. INFRA ENGINEERING: Receives 10-year ITI Bhiwadi O&M project under PM-SETU, diversifying into government-backed skill-development infrastructure.

* 📍 USFDA / REGULATORY

* ANTONY WASTE HANDLING CELL: Secures ₹243.22 Cr five-year Greater Noida contract for electric road sweeping machines and O&M.

* H.G. INFRA ENGINEERING: Receives LOA for 10-year O&M of ITI Bhiwadi Cluster under PM-SETU, with estimated project cost of ₹241 Cr.

* JUPITER WAGONS: Secures ₹211.27 Cr orders from JSW Port Logistics and Orissa Alloy Steel for 479 wagons.

* ADVAIT ENERGY TRANSITIONS: Wins ₹24.88 Cr GETCO turnkey order for Emergency Restoration Systems for 400kV transmission lines.

* AMAGI MEDIA LABS: Expands partnership with TV9 Network across CTV and digital operations, distribution and monetisation.

* GODREJ CONSUMER PRODUCTS: Appoints Aasif Malbari as Managing Director & CEO for a five-year term from August 12, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

* 📍 NEW PROJECTS

* BORANA WEAVES: Approves Unit 4 expansion with 192 Water Jet Looms and three texturising machines, with commercial production targeted by December 2026.

* ANANT RAJ: Targets expansion of data-centre capacity from 21 MW to 357 MW by 2032 across Manesar, Panchkula, Rai and Andhra Pradesh.

* TCPL PACKAGING: Plans ₹125 Cr investment over 18 months to enter lithium-ion battery separator film manufacturing, with commercial production targeted by Q4 FY28.

* PYRAMID TECHNOPLAST: Plans ₹20–25 Cr investment in a new Kutch facility adding 10,000 IBC units/month capacity, commissioning by March 2027.

* TEMBO GLOBAL: Commences solar power generation at four sites across Dhule and Jalgaon in Maharashtra.

* FLAIR WRITING: Subsidiary orders its fourth stainless-steel bottle manufacturing line, expected to increase capacity by ~35% by Q4 FY27.

* YATHARTH HOSPITAL: Developing a 250-bed super-speciality hospital in Gurugram with ₹200 Cr planned investment and operations targeted by Q1 FY28.

* 📍 FUNDRAISING

* VARDHMAN POLYTEX: Raised ₹75 Cr through NCDs and ₹15 Cr through OCDs to facilitate debt settlement with Phoenix ARC.

* 📍 ADDITIONS

* V-MART RETAIL: Crosses 600-store milestone after adding 100 stores in one year, with 24 new stores already opened in FY27 YTD across 338+ cities.

ZYDUS LIFESCIENCES: PARTNERS WITH SENTYNL FOR RARE LUNG DISEASE DRUG ALVELESTAT 💊🤝

• 🧬 Zydus’ US subsidiary Sentynl Therapeutics signs option & license agreement with Mereo BioPharma for alvelestat in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency-associated Lung Disease (AATD-LD)

• 💊 Alvelestat is a potential first-in-class oral treatment for AATD-LD and is being prepared for a global Phase 3 study

• 🇺🇸 On exercising the option, Sentynl gets exclusive U.S. commercialization rights; Mereo retains commercial rights for the rest of the world

• 💰 Mereo will receive a non-refundable option fee and could receive up to $40 million in upfront & R&D payments until NDA filing, plus double-digit royalties on U.S. sales

• 🏭 Sentynl also gets global manufacturing rights for alvelestat for AATD-LD

🟢 Impact: Positive – Deal expands Zydus/Sentynl’s rare-disease pipeline with a late-stage, potentially first-in-class therapy and provides exposure to future U.S. commercialization.

Nippon India Equity Opportunities AIF – Scheme 6 has acquired 15 lakh shares of Iris Clothings through a bulk deal at ₹55/share, representing an approximately 0.79% stake.

Deal Value: ₹8.25 Cr

About Iris Clothings:
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Howrah, West Bengal, Iris Clothings Limited is a listed children’s apparel company engaged in design, manufacturing, branding and distribution. The company operates 7 in-house manufacturing facilities and 2 warehouses, with an integrated model supporting scale, speed and quality control.

Iris Clothings has a distribution network of 140+ distributors across 26 states, with DOREME as its flagship brand alongside multiple brand verticals. The company has been listed on NSE since 2018.

_Nippon India’s ₹8.25 Cr bulk deal marks a significant institutional interest in the growing children’s apparel business._

🔴 Impact: Potentially Negative for private hospital chains if the recommendations translate into binding price controls, particularly caps on room tariffs and treatment-related charges.

Powerica: Guidance - - Concall Update

• Management reiterated double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27.

• Margins are expected to improve over the longer term through operating leverage, product mix improvements, and continued growth in engineering-led solutions.

• Genset business EBITDA margins are anticipated to be subdued in Q1 and part of Q2 due to geopolitical uncertainties and commodity price inflation, with improvement expected from Q3 onward.

• The IPP wind capacity is planned to reach 633.55 MW, with 50 MW added in the current financial year, 150 MW in the next year (FY28), and another 100 MW in the subsequent financial year.

• The data center order book of INR 900 crores (as of July 31, 2026) is expected to be executed over the next 12 to 18 months, with the data center revenue mix projected to be 20% plus on an annualized basis.

Carborundum Universal: Guidance - - Concall Update

• Management updated its FY27 guidance, expecting consolidated sales growth of 15% (excluding Foskor Zirconia and AWUKO), up from 11-12% previously.

• Consolidated Ceramics sales growth guidance was raised to 23-25% for FY27, from an earlier 15-15.5%.

• Consolidated Abrasives sales growth is maintained at 11-12% (excluding AWUKO), and Electro Minerals sales growth at 9-10% (excluding Foskor).

• Margin guidance for FY27 is retained: Consolidated Abrasives at 9.5-10% (excluding AWUKO loss), Ceramics at 20.5-21%, and Electro Minerals at 9-9.5% (excluding Foskor loss).

• The consolidated CapEx guidance for FY27 remains INR400 crores.

The Momentum Decoder: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (+60% in 1 month)

Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (NSE:KALYANKJIL) surged after posting a massive 46% jump in quarterly revenue, which triggered aggressive institutional buying despite some minor margin pressure. Smart money completely absorbed the initial post-earnings profit booking near ₹568, driving a sharp volume-backed recovery that pushed the stock to finish strong at ₹610.

Bottom Line: The structural growth is impressive, but chasing a vertical 60% rally leaves no margin of safety; wait for a healthy pullback toward ₹570 before considering new entries.

Yield Spike & Global Impact 🌍

The US 30Yr Treasury yield hit 5.28%, a high unseen since 2007. The US-Iran conflict pushed WTI Crude from $67 to $115/barrel before settling near $76.

Rising crude halted the inflation decline, sparking hawkish Federal Reserve shifts. The 10Yr Treasury yield has strong support at 4.5% and could hit 5%. The Dollar Index remains firm near 98.

Tactical Play: Elevated yields strengthen the USD but crush Gold and emerging equities. Gold ($4,341) faces downside risk to $3,800. The Nifty 50 and Indian Rupee will face bearish corrections.

🎯 Bottom Line: Oil-driven inflation fears have reignited US Treasury yields. Expect a strong US Dollar, capped upside for Gold, and delayed rallies in global equities until yields decisively fall.

NUVAMA ON TITAN

Rating: HOLD (Downgraded from BUY) , Target Price: ₹5,241 (Earlier ₹5,030)

• Q1 FY27 performance was strong with revenue up 36% YoY, EBITDA up 57% and net profit up 65%

• Jewellery revenue grew 43% to ₹15,900 Cr; domestic jewellery revenue rose 38%, with like-for-like growth of 33%

• Jewellery EBIT included an inventory gain of around ₹370 Cr; MTM inventory benefit was around 75–80 bps

• CaratLane revenue grew around 41%; EBIT margin improved sharply to 11.5% from 6.6%

• International jewellery revenue jumped 136%, but the segment reported an ₹8 Cr EBIT loss amid GCC geopolitical disruptions

• Watches and eyewear businesses both grew 22%

• Nuvama expects MTM benefits to moderate over the next 2–3 quarters, while customs-duty benefits could continue for another two quarters

• Despite strong fundamentals, the recent share-price rally has reduced upside potential, prompting the downgrade to HOLD.
